name: shot
caption:
THE SHOT 🎮🏀 May 12, 2019. Game 7 vs Philly, tied 90-90, 4.2 seconds left.

• Kawhi drifts to the corner over Embiid
• 1 bounce... 2... 3... 4... IN
• Raptors win 92-90, the first Game 7 buzzer-beater in NBA history
• Kawhi: 41 PTS
• A month later: NBA champions

Where were you when it dropped? 👇

beats.head: THE SHOT
beats.vo: May twelfth, twenty nineteen. Game seven against Philly. Tied at ninety, with four seconds left.

beats.head: 4.2 SECONDS
beats.vo: Kawhi Leonard gets it, drifts to the corner... and fires over Joel Embiid.
beats.dlg: KAWHI DRIFTS TO THE CORNER...|OVER EMBIID!

beats.head: THE SHOT
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: One bounce. Two. Three. Four... and in.

beats.head: RAPTORS WIN
beats.vo: Raptors win, ninety-two to ninety. The first Game seven buzzer-beater in NBA history.

beats.head: KAWHI'S NIGHT
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: Kawhi finished with forty-one. A month later, Toronto had its first title.

beats.head: WE THE NORTH
beats.vo: Where were you when it dropped? Comment below.
